facts.fact: Seychelles News Agency reports a proposed private members' Pro-Human Technology Bill that would protect against audio and visual digital forgeries and prohibit certain high-risk technologies; the Speaker says it is far from reaching the National Assembly.

SYC.note: DICT says it emphasises AI for service efficiency but names no system in use or tested.
No sectoral AI tool is stated.
No locally built or hosted AI model, dataset or computing is stated.
